text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with information concerning negotiations with International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE) Local 822.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the bargaining mandate for negotiations with International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE) Local 822, all as more particularly noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 5, 2018) from the Director of Production, Civic Theatres Toronto. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 5, 2018) from the Director of Production, Civic Theatres Toronto, remain confidential as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
